strings.AccessDenied.Camera:
Regram needs access to your camera to take photos and videos.

Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera and enable Regram.
strings.AccessDenied.VideoMicrophone:
Regram needs access to your microphone to record sound in videos.

Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone and enable Regram.
strings.AntiFeatures.Notice: Only affects what is kept on this device. Messages you delete yourself are still removed.
strings.AntiRevoke.Chats.Empty: No chats yet. Open a chat's profile and turn on "Keep Deleted Messages".
strings.AntiRevoke.Chats.Notice: Messages deleted in these chats are kept and marked as deleted. Swipe left to remove; tap to open the profile.
strings.AntiRevoke.Chats.Title: Chats Keeping Deleted Messages
strings.AntiRevoke.PerChat.AllChats: Deleted messages are kept in all chats. You can change this in Regram Pro → Anti-Deletion & Restrictions.
strings.AntiRevoke.PerChat.Notice: When on, messages deleted by the other side in this chat are kept and marked as deleted.
strings.AntiRevoke.PerChat.Title: Keep Deleted Messages
strings.AppBadge.Notice: Choose a style once; the badge follows the interface's light or dark appearance. Previews are enlarged; screenshots use the normal size.
strings.AppBadge.Title: App Badge
strings.AppUpdate.ActivityDownloaded: Downloaded. Open Regram to finish preparing the update.
strings.AppUpdate.ActivityStale: Progress will refresh when Regram can run
strings.AppUpdate.AutomaticExitNotice: Exit automatically after the system receives the complete update package. A rejected or interrupted installation request does not close Regram.
strings.AppUpdate.AutomaticNotice: Check GitHub Releases when Regram opens, at most once every six hours. With automatic download enabled, tap Update to download and sign in the background, then confirm installation when ready. LCSign provides the installation manifest.
strings.AppUpdate.CacheError: Unable to save or verify the update cache. Please try again.
strings.AppUpdate.CertificateImported: Certificate saved on this device and matched to the installed app. It remains available after restarting or updating Regram, until you remove it.
strings.AppUpdate.CertificateMismatch: Use the same certificate that signed the currently installed Regram.
strings.AppUpdate.CertificateNotice: Select one P12/PFX certificate and its provisioning profiles together, then enter the password to verify and save them. Use the same certificate that installed Regram. Matching profiles from the installed app are included automatically. Files and password stay in this device’s Keychain.
strings.AppUpdate.CertificateSelection: Select exactly one P12/PFX certificate, together with any matching .mobileprovision files.
strings.AppUpdate.HashMismatch: The downloaded package failed verification. Please retry.
strings.AppUpdate.IdentityMismatch: The update’s version or extension layout does not match this installation.
strings.AppUpdate.ImportTooLarge: The selected file exceeds the 256 KB import limit.
strings.AppUpdate.ImportUnreadable: Unable to read this file. Download it to Files first, then select it again.
strings.AppUpdate.ImportWrongType: Choose a P12/PFX certificate or a .mobileprovision file for the matching import action.
strings.AppUpdate.InstallPrompt: Regram %@ has been downloaded and verified. Install the update now?
strings.AppUpdate.InstallReading: iOS is reading the signed update package…
strings.AppUpdate.InstallRequested: Installation requested. Confirm in the iOS prompt, then reopen Regram.
strings.AppUpdate.InstallationChannelEnded: The local installation connection has ended. If the update was not installed, retry with the saved signed package.
strings.AppUpdate.InstallationNotStarted: No update package request was detected. If no iOS installation prompt appeared, tap Install Update to retry with the saved signed package.
strings.AppUpdate.InstallationRejected: iOS could not open the installation link. The signed package is saved; you can retry installation.
strings.AppUpdate.InstalledEntitlementsInvalid: Unable to read the installed app or extension’s signing permissions.
strings.AppUpdate.InstallerReceived: Update package delivered to the system installer. Reopen Regram after installation to confirm the new version.
strings.AppUpdate.InvalidArchive: Unable to unpack or package this update.
strings.AppUpdate.InvalidCertificate: The P12 certificate, password or validity period is incorrect.
strings.AppUpdate.InvalidManifest: The installation service returned an invalid installation manifest.
strings.AppUpdate.InvalidProfile: A matching, unexpired profile is required for the app and every extension.
strings.AppUpdate.InvalidRelease: The release metadata is invalid or missing its SHA-256 checksum.
strings.AppUpdate.KeychainError: Unable to save credentials to the device Keychain.
strings.AppUpdate.LiveActivity: Show update progress in Live Activities
strings.AppUpdate.NetworkError: Unable to connect. Check your network and installation service, then retry.
strings.AppUpdate.NotConfigured: Import the same certificate used to install Regram first.
strings.AppUpdate.ProfileAppIDMismatch: The provisioning profiles do not cover this app or extension’s identifier.
strings.AppUpdate.ProfileCertificateMismatch: The provisioning profiles do not include the certificate used to install this app.
strings.AppUpdate.ProfileEntitlementMismatch: The provisioning profiles do not allow one of the installed app or extension’s permissions.
strings.AppUpdate.ProfileExpired: The matching provisioning profiles have expired. Import renewed profiles.
strings.AppUpdate.ProfileLimit: Up to 64 provisioning profiles can be saved.
strings.AppUpdate.ProfileMissing: No provisioning profile is available. Import the profiles used to install this app and its extensions.
strings.AppUpdate.ProfileUnreadable: Unable to read this provisioning profile. Import the original .mobileprovision file.
strings.AppUpdate.Ready: The update is ready to install
strings.AppUpdate.ServiceNotice: LCSign provides the HTTPS installation manifest. The signed IPA is delivered through this device’s local loopback connection. Your certificate, password and IPA are not uploaded. If a node fails, Regram tries the next one.
strings.AppUpdate.SigningFailed: Signing failed. Check your certificate and provisioning profiles.
strings.AppUpdate.Title: Regram Updates
strings.AppUpdate.TrollStoreNotStarted: TrollStore has not requested the update package. Enable its URL Scheme option and retry. Opening Magnifier means the scheme is not handled by TrollStore.
strings.AppUpdate.TrollStoreNotice: Download and verify the IPA from GitHub Releases, then install through TrollStore without a certificate. With automatic download enabled, tap Update to download in the background, then confirm installation when ready. Enable the URL Scheme in TrollStore settings first.
strings.AppUpdate.TrollStoreReceived: Update delivered to TrollStore. Finish installation there, then reopen Regram to confirm the new version.
strings.AppUpdate.TrollStoreUnavailable: Unable to open the TrollStore installer. Make sure TrollStore is installed and its URL Scheme option is enabled.
strings.AppUpdate.UpToDate: You are using the latest version
strings.Auth.AccountBackupReminder: Make sure you have a backup access method. Keep a SIM for SMS or an additional session logged in to avoid being locked out.
strings.Auth.UnofficialAppCodeTitle: You can get the code only with official app
strings.AuthorMessages.Empty: This user has no visible messages in this chat.
strings.AuthorMessages.LoadFailed: Messages could not be loaded. Please try again.
strings.AuthorMessages.Paused: Search paused. Loaded messages are still available.
strings.AuthorMessages.Scope: Searches messages accessible to this account in the current group or topic. Local message filters remain active.
strings.AuthorMessages.Title: Messages from %1$@
strings.AuthorMessages.Unavailable: This group or sender is unavailable to this account.
strings.Backup.Done: Settings updated. Restart to refresh every open screen.
strings.Backup.Error: Could Not Import or Export Settings
strings.Backup.Error.Notice: Choose a valid Regram settings JSON file up to 2 MB. Unsupported versions, invalid types and out-of-range values are rejected.
strings.Backup.Fonts.Notice: Font files must be downloaded or imported separately. Missing fonts use the system fallback. Rules scoped to accounts/chats keep their original IDs.
strings.Backup.Notice: Backs up Regram preferences, rules, font selections and related navigation controls. Account sessions and font files are excluded. Import always opens a preview before applying changes.
strings.Backup.Reset.Notice: Selected categories return to their defaults. This does not clear messages or account sessions.
strings.Backup.Restore.Notice: Replace the selected categories with the previewed settings? Other categories are preserved.
strings.Backup.Title: Configuration Backup
strings.BlockUser.Notice: Messages from this user or bot will be hidden locally in every chat. They will not be notified.
strings.Bookmarks.ChatUnavailable: The original chat is not available locally. You can still edit or remove this bookmark.
strings.Bookmarks.Notice: Bookmarks and tags are saved only for this account on this device. They keep a reference to the original message, not a copy.
strings.Bookmarks.TagsNotice: Choose existing tags or add your own. Each message supports up to 10 tags, with 32 characters per tag.
strings.Bookmarks.Title: Message Bookmarks & Tags
strings.Bookmarks.Unavailable: Message is not cached locally. Tap to try opening it.
strings.Browser.Translation.Failed: Page translation failed or timed out. You can restore the original page and try again.
strings.Browser.Translation.NoText: This page has no readable text to translate.
strings.Browser.Translation.SystemUnavailable: Apple webpage translation requires iOS 18 or later. Select another translation service on this device.
strings.Browser.Translation.TooLarge: This page is too large to translate. Try opening a shorter article.
strings.CallConfirmation.Audio.Title: Make a Call?
strings.CallConfirmation.Video.Title: Make a Video Call?
strings.Chat.NextChannelArchivedSwipeAction: Release to go to archived channels
strings.Chat.NextChannelArchivedSwipeProgress: Swipe up to go to archived channels
strings.Chat.NextChannelFolderSwipeAction: Release to go to the %@ folder
strings.Chat.NextChannelFolderSwipeProgress: Swipe up to go to the %@ folder

strings.Chat.NextChannelUnarchivedSwipeProgress: Swipe up to go to unarchived channels

strings.Chat.NextUnreadTopicSwipeProgress: Pull up to go to the next topic
strings.ChatPreferences.Notice: Overrides apply to this account and the selected chat, including its topics. Explicit send-without-formatting still takes precedence.
strings.ChatPreferences.Reveal.Notice: Temporarily shows keyword-filtered and hidden-sender messages locally in this chat. Rules are retained and resume automatically. Notification filtering is unchanged.
strings.ChatPreferences.Title: Per-Chat Settings
strings.Common.KnowWhatYouDo: Please, change these settings only if you know what they do.
strings.Common.UseTelegramForPremium: Please note that to get Telegram Premium, you must use the official Telegram app. Once you have obtained Telegram Premium, all its features will become available in Regram.
strings.CommonGroups.Empty: No messages to display in this scope.
strings.CommonGroups.EmptyHint: Try another group or refresh the search.
strings.CommonGroups.Failed: The search did not finish. Tap Retry to continue.
strings.CommonGroups.Media: Media or service message (tap to view)
strings.CommonGroups.OpenMessage: Open the original message in its group
strings.CommonGroups.PartialFailure: Some queries did not finish. Retry to continue; loaded results are retained.
strings.CommonGroups.Paused: Search paused. Loaded messages are still available.
strings.CommonGroups.Scope: Searches messages accessible to this account in common groups. Anonymous posts and messages sent under other identities are not attributed to this person.
strings.CommonGroups.Title: %1$@ · Common Groups
strings.CommonGroups.Unavailable: This user’s common groups are unavailable to this account.
strings.ContextMenu.viewAuthorMessages: View All Messages from This User
strings.DNSDiagnostics.Failed: No address for this family, or resolution failed
strings.DNSDiagnostics.NoPolicyAddresses: No address matches the selected policy.
strings.DNSDiagnostics.Notice: Query A and AAAA independently without the app cache, then show addresses allowed by the selected policy. The duration measures DNS resolution, not DC ping. This test does not save settings and cancels when you leave.
strings.DNSDiagnostics.PolicyAddresses: Addresses allowed by the IP policy
strings.DNSDiagnostics.Title: DNS and IP resolution test
strings.Debug.ClearCache.Info: Clear cached media for this account and web/network caches. Locally cached media may become unavailable until downloaded again. Keeps accounts, messages, settings, certificates and saved edit-history images.
strings.Debug.NotificationExperiment.Info: Off by default. Attempts to recover unresolved encrypted notifications and remove placeholder alerts. Keeps message previews and app-lock privacy. iOS may still show an alert when the service extension cannot run.
strings.Diagnostics.Connection.Title: Connection Status
strings.Diagnostics.DC.Notice: Uses Telegram requests through the current in-app connection. One initial request includes connection/authentication setup; three subsequent requests measure round-trip latency. Each request has an 8-second timeout. These are RPC timings, not ICMP ping or bandwidth. Leaving the page or backgrounding stops testing.
strings.Diagnostics.DC.Title: DC1–DC5 Connection Test
strings.Diagnostics.Download.Notice: Media payload received during this app session across accounts, including re-downloads. Rate is averaged over the last three seconds. Cached/local reads, font downloads and protocol overhead are excluded.
strings.Diagnostics.Filter.Notice: Tests 100 local synthetic messages against the current rules without chat restrictions and shows average time per message. No messages are sent. The result does not measure scrolling frame rate.
strings.Diagnostics.Media.Notice: Media loading follows Telegram automatic-download and network controls. Compare real transfer behavior when toggling the experiment; no fixed speed gain is promised.
strings.Diagnostics.Title: Performance & Transfer
strings.EditHistory.Notice: Only versions observed on this device are recorded. Saved photos survive media cache cleanup; uncached originals may no longer be available. Secret, self-destructing and protected photos are not retained.
strings.EditHistory.PhotoUnavailable: Could not load this photo. Its file reference may have expired or it was not saved locally.
strings.EditHistory.Title: Edit History
strings.EraseData.Confirm: This logs out every account and deletes all local data of this app. This cannot be undone.
strings.EraseData.ContainerUnavailable: The data container is unavailable. The request is saved; reopen Regram to retry.
strings.EraseData.DoneNotice: Close Regram and open it again to start fresh.
strings.EraseData.Notice: Logs out every account and deletes all local data, caches and settings. Use this to start over — deleting the app does not clear its data, because iOS keeps the shared container alive.
strings.EraseData.Progress: Erasing data… Please keep Regram open.
strings.EraseData.Title: Erase All Data
strings.Fonts.Areas.Notice: Checked areas update immediately. Code, icons and large emoji keep their own fonts.
strings.Fonts.Chinese.Sample: 中文字体示例：你好，世界。
strings.Fonts.Chinese.Title: Chinese Font
strings.Fonts.ClearDownloads.Notice: Clear downloaded fonts and restore built-in selections to the system font? Imported font files are retained.
strings.Fonts.Cloud.Notice: Fonts download on demand from official sources and remain available offline.
strings.Fonts.Delete.Notice: Delete this font from your library? A selected font returns to the system font. Other faces in the same TTC remain available.
strings.Fonts.Download.Error: Download failed. Check your connection and try again. Your current font is unchanged.
strings.Fonts.Error.Title: Fonts
strings.Fonts.Fallback: Characters outside the selected fonts use system fallback. Code and large emoji keep their own fonts.
strings.Fonts.Import.Error: Could not import the font. Choose a valid TTF, OTF or TTC file up to 64 MB.
strings.Fonts.Import.Notice: Supports TTF, OTF and TTC up to 64 MB. Every supported face in a TTC appears in your library. English and Chinese are selected independently.
strings.Fonts.Latin.Title: English and Latin Font
strings.Fonts.Management.Error: Could not update font storage. Please try again.
strings.Fonts.More.Notice: Poppins and Lora appear in Anthropic’s published brand-style example. Plex Sans SC and Noto Serif SC include Chinese glyphs; their italic emphasis uses an oblique style.
strings.Fonts.NoArea: Select an area to apply this font.
strings.Fonts.Rename.Notice: Give this font a name of up to 80 characters. The font file is unchanged.
strings.Fonts.Sample: 聊天文字 · 中文字体自动回退
strings.Fonts.Scripts.Notice: English letters, digits and Latin punctuation use the English font. Han characters and Chinese punctuation use the Chinese font. Both choices apply to the checked areas.
strings.Fonts.Title: Fonts
strings.FreshInstall.ReadyText: The app will now close. Open it again to confirm and erase everything.
strings.FreshInstall.Text:
Deleting this app does not remove its data — iOS keeps the shared container, so the accounts and settings from the previous install are still here.

Keep using them, or start over?
strings.FreshInstall.Title: Data From a Previous Install
strings.Ghost.Notice: Stops this device from reporting which stories you view, your online status and your typing. Nothing changes on your side: stories still clear. Sending a message still puts you online — that part is decided by the server, not by the app.
strings.GroupRemark.Notice: Only visible to this account on this device. The name appears in the chat list, chat title and local search. Leave it empty and save to use the original group name.
strings.GroupRemark.Title: Group Remark
strings.HiddenUsers.Empty: No hidden users yet. Open a user's or bot's profile and turn on "Hide This User's Messages".
strings.HiddenUsers.Notice: Messages from these users and bots are hidden everywhere. Swipe left to unhide; tap to open the profile.
strings.HiddenUsers.Title: Hidden Users
strings.InputToolbar.Title: Formatting Panel
strings.JoinFolder.Picker.Title: Add “%@” to a folder
strings.JoinFolder.Setting.Notice: After you join a group or channel, Regram offers to add it to one of your chat folders.
strings.JoinFolder.Unavailable: This chat could not be added. The folder may have been deleted or reached its chat limit. Tidy up your folders and try again.
strings.LLMTranslation.ConnectionNotice: Requests go to the configured service. The API key is stored only in this device’s Keychain and is excluded from settings backups. Leave URLs empty to use the selected API format’s defaults.
strings.LLMTranslation.KeySaveFailed: Unable to save the API key in Keychain.
strings.LLMTranslation.PromptNotice: Use @text for the message and @toLang for the target language. Chat context includes up to five earlier messages from the same chat/topic (800 characters each), sent only when this option is enabled.
strings.LLMTranslation.Title: LLM Translation
strings.LanguagePack.Description: Shared Regram language pack for iOS and macOS.
strings.LanguagePack.Name: Regram English
strings.LinkPreview.Disable.Notice: Sends links without webpage previews. The preview can still appear while composing, and messages from other people are unaffected.
strings.LinkPreview.InvalidHost: Enter a domain without a scheme, path or port. Invalid input does not replace the saved service.
strings.LinkPreview.Repair.Notice: Use preview services for supported links. Message text and original links remain unchanged.
strings.LocalGifts.BalanceHint: Enter a whole number from 0 to 9000000000000000, then save.
strings.LocalGifts.Disabled: Enable local gift purchases in Regram settings first.
strings.LocalGifts.Insufficient: Not enough local Stars. Edit the balance in the local customization section.
strings.LocalGifts.InsufficientTon: Not enough local TON. Edit the balance in the local customization section.
strings.LocalGifts.InvalidAmount: Enter a valid non-negative amount within the allowed range.
strings.LocalGifts.Limit: Local gifts have reached the storage limit (up to 500 gifts). Remove some gifts and try again.
strings.LocalGifts.NativeHint: Save the balance, then buy ordinary or collectible gifts in Telegram’s existing gift screens. The catalog and previews load online; purchases and balance deductions are simulated locally.
strings.LocalGifts.Notice: Purchases use separate local Stars and TON balances. Gifts and styles appear only on your own profile on this device. Turning this off hides them and keeps your records.
strings.LocalGifts.OwnedHint: Local purchases never send a payment or gift request. They cannot be transferred, sold, upgraded or exchanged with Telegram.
strings.LocalGifts.PinnedLimit: The pinned gift limit has been reached. Unpin another gift first.
strings.LocalGifts.RemoveHint: Remove this local gift? Local Stars will not be refunded.
strings.LocalGifts.StorageError: The local record could not be saved, or the gift preview has not finished loading. No purchase was completed.
strings.LocalGifts.SuccessHint: The local balance was charged and the gift was added to your profile on this device.
strings.LocalGifts.Title: Local Stars & Gifts
strings.LocalGifts.TonHint: Used for local collectible purchases and the local profile card. Up to 9 decimal places, maximum 9000000 TON. No wallet or payment transfer is made.
strings.LocalPhone.Hint: Changes the number shown on your own profile and Settings on this device. Your login number and Telegram account stay unchanged. Each account has its own setting.
strings.LocalPhone.Invalid: Enter a 1–3 digit country code and a phone number, with 5–20 digits in total.
strings.LocalPhone.Title: Local phone display
strings.LocalPremium.Notice: Treats your accounts as Premium inside this app, so Premium-only screens, options and limits unlock. Nothing is sent to Telegram: anything the server checks — premium stickers and reactions, emoji status, real limits — still needs a subscription.
strings.LocalPremium.Title: Local Premium
strings.LocalRating.Hint: Changes the rating on your own profile on this device. Negative values use Telegram’s low-credit style. Your real rating stays unchanged.
strings.LocalRating.Invalid: Enter a whole number from −999 to 999.
strings.LocalRating.Title: Local profile rating
strings.LocalWallet.Hint: Tap the balance on your profile to open Telegram’s card. Up to six pinned local collectible gifts decorate it. Turning this off restores the real profile card.
strings.LocalWallet.Notice: This balance and card are displayed only on this device. They have no receiving address and are invisible to other users.
strings.LocalWallet.Title: Local TON profile card
strings.Media.ClipboardOriginalImages.Notice: Copy the complete original image. Paste images as photos at the highest encoding quality, within the native photo size and format limits. Clipboard image data stays intact until photo preparation.
strings.MediaMetadata.NotDownloaded: Some details are unavailable until the media is fully downloaded.
strings.MediaMetadata.Setting.Notice: Adds "Media Info" to the photo and video viewer menu: resolution, file size, duration, frame rate, bitrate and codec, read from the downloaded file.
strings.MediaMetadata.Title: Media Info
strings.Mention.UserIdLink.Notice: Long-pressing an avatar to mention inserts the user's full name as a mention instead of @username. Tapping it opens their profile.
strings.MessageFilter.ImportFailed: No message filter rules could be read from this file.
strings.MessageFilter.ImportPreview.ConflictNoti: Rules with reused IDs are added separately with new IDs. Existing rules are kept.
strings.MessageFilter.ImportPreview.Notice: Import adds the rules below. Existing rules are kept, and rules with the same definition are skipped.
strings.MessageFilter.ImportPreview.Title: Review Rules
strings.MessageFilter.Imported: Imported %@ rules into the message filter.
strings.MessageFilter.Keywords.Title: Keywords
strings.MessageFilter.PerChat.Notice: When off, the message filter is ignored in this chat.
strings.MessageFilter.PerChat.Title: Message Filter
strings.MessageFilter.Regex.Notice: Matching is case-insensitive. Regular expressions use ICU syntax; an invalid pattern cannot be added.
strings.MessageFilter.Rule.EditMessage: Messages containing this text will be hidden.
strings.MessageFilter.Rule.EditMessageRegex: Messages matching this regular expression will be hidden.
strings.MessageFilter.Rules.Notice: Tap a rule to limit it to specific chats. Touch and hold for more options.
strings.MessageFilter.SelectChats.Title: Filter in Chats
strings.MessageFilter.SubTitle:
Remove distractions and hide messages matching the rules below.
Matching is case-insensitive.
strings.MessageFilter.Test.Notice: Tests the current rules without hiding or sending this text. Conversation restrictions are not applied in this preview. Keep rules override hide rules in applicable chats; hidden users remain hidden. Slow regex matches are stopped and keep the message visible.
strings.MessageFilter.Test.Title: Test Rules
strings.MessageFilter.Title: Message Filter
strings.MessageScreenshot.Unavailable: Some selected messages are unavailable or cannot be exported.
strings.MutualContact.Label: mutual contact
strings.NetworkPolicy.Applied: Network policy saved. Native Telegram connections will reconnect.
strings.NetworkPolicy.BackupNotice: Keep saved and built-in DC addresses, but stop additional backup-address discovery.
strings.NetworkPolicy.DNSExclusive: Select one DNS resolution mode. Saving reconnects native Telegram transport.
strings.NetworkPolicy.DoHFailure.network: Unable to connect to the custom DNS service.
strings.NetworkPolicy.DoHFailure.noAddress: The resolver returned no address for this family.
strings.NetworkPolicy.DoHFailure.response: The custom DNS service returned an invalid response.
strings.NetworkPolicy.DoHNotice: Built-in DNS uses Google and Cloudflare over HTTPS. System DNS resolves proxy hostnames through iOS. Custom DoH uses DNS JSON and also serves signed backup-DC TXT queries; existing wire-format address endpoints remain compatible. A custom resolver failure never downgrades to system DNS. Resolver hostnames still use system DNS to bootstrap.
strings.NetworkPolicy.IPNotice: Applies to native Telegram connections and SOCKS5/MTProto proxy addresses. Preferred modes allow the other family as a fallback; only modes do not. Webpages, updates, DNS HTTP requests and Web proxies use the system network.
strings.NetworkPolicy.InvalidURL: Enter an HTTPS URL without a username, password, query or fragment.
strings.NetworkPolicy.Title: DNS and IP policy
strings.Notifications.ContentFilter.Notice: Applies keyword rules, keep rules and hidden senders after a push message is resolved locally. Requires a shared App Group. Unresolved pushes cannot be matched reliably.
strings.Notifications.ContentFilter.Unavailable: Shared preferences are unavailable with this signature. Enable a working App Group when signing to use notification filtering.
strings.Notifications.MentionsAndReplies.Title: @Mentions and Replies
strings.Notifications.PinnedMessages.Title: Pinned Messages
strings.OutgoingFormatting.Notice: Applies the selected style to new text messages when sent. Existing manual formatting is kept; code, quotes, and custom emoji are excluded.
strings.OutgoingFormatting.Title: Default Message Formatting
strings.Pangu.Notice: Inserts a space between CJK characters and adjacent Latin letters or digits in messages you send. Code and quote blocks are left untouched.
strings.Pangu.Title: Pangu spacing
strings.PayWall.About.Notice:
Free version of Regram provides dozens of features and improvements over Telegram app. Innovating and keeping Regram in sync with monthly Telegram updates is a huge effort that requires a lot of time and expensive hardware.

Regram is an open-source app that respects your privacy and doesn't bother you with ads. Subscribing to Regram Pro you get access to exclusive features and support an independent developer.
strings.PayWall.About.Title: About Regram Pro
strings.PayWall.AppIcons.Notice: Customize Regram look on your home screen and screenshots.
strings.PayWall.AppIcons.Title: Unique App Icons and Badges
strings.PayWall.InputToolbar.Description: Apply and clear Formatting or insert new lines like a Pro.
strings.PayWall.InputToolbar.Notice: Bold, Italic, Links? Formatting with just a single tap.
strings.PayWall.InputToolbar.Title: Formatting Panel
strings.PayWall.MessageFilter.Description: Create a list of keywords you don't want to see and Regram will hide messages containing them.
strings.PayWall.MessageFilter.Notice: Hide SPAM, promotions and annoying messages.
strings.PayWall.MessageFilter.Title: Message Filter
strings.PayWall.Notice.Markdown: By subscribing to Regram Pro you agree to the [Regram Terms of Service](%1$@) and [Privacy Policy](%2$@).
strings.PayWall.Notice.Raw: By subscribing to Regram Pro you agree to the Regram Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
strings.PayWall.Notifications.Description: No more Pinned Messages or @mentions when you need some peace of mind.
strings.PayWall.Notifications.Title: Disable @mentions and replies
strings.PayWall.ProSupport.Title: Troubles with payment?
strings.PayWall.ValidationError.Expired: Your subscription expired. Subscribe again to regain access to Pro features.
strings.PayWall.ValidationError.TryAgain: Something went wrong during purchase validation. No worries! Try to Restore Purchases a bit later.
strings.Paywall.Error.Title: Error
strings.ProfileBadge.coreTester.Info: A core tester helping verify Regram.
strings.ProxySettings.UseSystemDNS.Notice: Use the system resolver for proxy hostnames. Enabling this disables custom DoH; changes reconnect immediately.
strings.QrLogin.Accepted.Text: The QR code was accepted. Finishing login…
strings.QrLogin.Accepted.Title: Logging In
strings.QrLogin.ConnectionTimedOut: Connecting to Telegram timed out. Check your connection or proxy and retry.
strings.QrLogin.InitializationTimedOut: Connected to Telegram, but initializing the login connection timed out. Retrying…
strings.QrLogin.LoadFailed: Unable to load the QR code. Check your network or proxy and retry.
strings.QrLogin.NetworkUnavailable: No network connection is available. Reconnect to the network and retry.
strings.QrLogin.RenderFailed: Unable to render the QR code. Please retry.
strings.QrLogin.RequestError: Telegram rejected the login token request: %1$@
strings.QrLogin.RequestTimedOut: The login token request timed out. Check your Telegram connection or proxy and retry.

1. Open Telegram on a device where you are already logged in.
2. Go to Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device.
3. Scan this code to log in.

strings.QrLogin.TooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Trying again shortly…
strings.RG.BottomBarLayout.Footer: Drag navigation buttons in the preview to change their order. Chats and Settings are always visible. Enable Search with the other bottom bar controls; its native button opens search for the current page. Top Search is independent. A standalone navigation button temporarily joins the tabs while Search is enabled. Automatic width follows visible items; turn it off to adjust the width manually.
strings.RG.BottomBarLayout.SearchStyle.BarDisabl: Chats and Settings stay visible; search uses a standalone button.
strings.RG.BottomBarLayout.TopSearchHint.hidden: Top search is hidden. Toggle it in State below.
strings.RG.BottomBarLayout.TopSearchHint.visible: Top search is shown. Toggle it in State below.
strings.RG.STT.Error.Cancelled: Transcription cancelled. Tap to try again.
strings.RG.STT.Error.Download: Unable to download the audio. Please try again.
strings.RG.STT.Error.FileTooLarge: The audio exceeds the 25 MB upload limit.
strings.RG.STT.Error.InvalidAudio: Unable to prepare a valid audio file.
strings.RG.STT.Error.InvalidLanguage: Use a two-letter language code such as zh or en, or leave it empty for automatic detection.
strings.RG.STT.Error.InvalidResponse: The API response does not contain a valid transcription.
strings.RG.STT.Error.InvalidURL: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS API URL without embedded credentials. OpenAI requires HTTPS.
strings.RG.STT.Error.Keychain: Unable to access the API key in this device’s Keychain. Please try saving it again.
strings.RG.STT.Error.MissingAPIKey: An API key is required for api.openai.com.
strings.RG.STT.Error.Timeout: Transcription timed out. Please try again.
strings.RG.STTAPIKey.Placeholder: Required for OpenAI; optional for local services
strings.RG.STTPrompt.Footer: Optional hints to help recognize names and terminology. Support depends on the selected transcription model.
strings.RG.STTSettings.Footer: Changes are saved automatically. Empty Base URL and Endpoint use the OpenAI defaults; Endpoint can also be a full URL. API Key is stored in this device’s Keychain and is not synced with iCloud. Returning to Default stops using the custom provider.
strings.RG.STTTest.Footer: Uploads a built-in short audio sample to the configured API to verify transcription. It does not use your chat audio. Your provider may charge for this request.
strings.RG.STTUsage: Recognize a voice message or round video, then translate the resulting text from its message menu.
strings.RecentChats.Notice: Chats you opened on this device, newest first. Long-press a chat's back button to jump to one. Swipe to remove.
strings.RecentChats.Title: Recent Chats
strings.RecurringMessages.Info: Starting on the selected date, silently send once on the first Regram launch each day. Later launches that day do not repeat it. Tasks stay on this device and skip missed days; the selected time does not apply. Edit or delete the task in Scheduled Messages.
strings.Revoked.Clear.Notice: Permanently remove the loaded retained messages from this device? Only records still marked revoked are removed. Other messages and other users are unaffected.
strings.Revoked.Empty: No matching retained messages in the loaded history.
strings.Revoked.Notice: Choose a chat to browse messages retained on this device. Confirmed deletions and previously unavailable history are identified separately. Load More reads older local records; dates show original message dates.
strings.Revoked.Title: Retained Revoked Messages
strings.Revoked.Unavailable: Previously unavailable on the server · retained locally
strings.RevokedMarker.InvalidColor: Enter #RRGGBB, or leave blank to follow the timestamp color.
strings.RevokedMarker.Notice: Customize the marker beside the timestamp of locally retained deleted messages. Leave text blank for the default label and color blank to follow the theme. This does not change deletion rules.
strings.RevokedMarker.Saved: Saved. Visible retained messages now use this marker.
strings.RevokedMarker.Title: Deleted-message marker
strings.Settings.AutomaticallyRevealSpoilers.Not: Show spoiler text, photos and videos without tapping. Disabled by default.
strings.Settings.CallConfirmation.Notice: Regram will ask for your confirmation before making a call.
strings.Settings.ContextMenu.Notice: Disabled entries will be available in "Regram" sub-menu.
strings.Settings.CustomColors.Saturation.Notice: Set to 0%% to disable account colors.
strings.Settings.DefaultEmojisFirst.Notice: Show standard emojis before premium in emoji keyboard
strings.Settings.DownloadsBoost.Notice: Increase concurrent downloads and chunk size when enabled.

strings.Settings.Editor.summarySettings.Descript: Separate API, model and prompt settings
strings.Settings.Editor.transcriptionSettings.De: Recognition service, custom API and language
strings.Settings.Folders.RememberLast.Notice: Open the selected destination when restarting the app or switching accounts. If a folder is unavailable, All Chats opens instead.
strings.Settings.HidePhoneInSettingsUI.Notice: This will only hide your phone number from the settings interface. To hide it from others, go to Privacy and Security.
strings.Settings.MediaLoading.Title: Downloads & Playback
strings.Settings.MediaLoadingExperiment.Notice: Prepare photos and videos ahead of time and reduce waits when scrolling back. Turn off to compare with the original behavior.
strings.Settings.NY.Notice: Available for a limited time only!
strings.Settings.Photo.Quality.Notice: Quality of uploaded photos and stories.
strings.Settings.Photo.SendLarge.Notice: Increase the side limit on compressed images to 2560px.
strings.Settings.Pro.Title: Regram Pro
strings.Settings.ProCategory.appearance.Descript: Fonts, icons, bottom bar and profiles
strings.Settings.ProCategory.media.Description: Link previews, photos, stickers and playback
strings.Settings.ProCategory.messages.Descriptio: Message actions, chat list and folders
strings.Settings.ProCategory.privacy.Description: Content filters, deleted messages and privacy
strings.Settings.ProCategory.tools.Description: Backup, app updates and local data
strings.Settings.ProHub.Notice: Message tools, privacy, translation, transcription, media and backups are in Regram Pro.
strings.Settings.Profiles.DefaultTabGroupsInComm: Show the Groups tab first when opening a user or bot you share groups with.
strings.Settings.ShowCreationDate.Notice: The creation date may be unknown for some chats.
strings.Settings.Tabs.WideTabBar.Notice: Keeps the full width of Tab bar when some tabs are hidden.
strings.Settings.Tabs.Width.Hidden: The tab bar is currently hidden. Turn off Hide Tab Bar to display it.
strings.Settings.Tabs.Width.Notice: Choose 50–100% of the available width (up to 500 pt). The bar keeps enough room for each tab. Changes apply immediately.
strings.Settings.Transcription.Backend.Notice: Regram will fallback to %@ if selected transcription service is not available.
strings.Settings.Translation.Backend.Notice: Regram will fallback to %@ if selected translation service is not available.
strings.Settings.UnlimitedPinnedChats.Notice: Telegram syncs only as many pins as your account allows (5, or 10 with Premium). The topmost ones are synced; pins beyond that stay on this device only.
strings.Settings.forceBuiltInMic.Notice: If enabled, app will use only device microphone even if headphones are connected.
strings.Showroom.Description: Local Premium, gifts, rating, TON card and phone display
strings.Showroom.PremiumRefresh: Reopen the app to refresh screens that are already open.
strings.Showroom.Title: Show Off
strings.StickerBackup.Failed: Sticker pack backup failed. Check download access and available storage, then retry.
strings.StickerSave.Failed: Unable to save sticker. Check Photos permission and try again.
strings.Stories.Warning.Author: Author
strings.Stories.Warning.Notice: %@ WILL BE ABLE TO SEE that you viewed their Story.
strings.Stories.Warning.NoticeStealth: %@ will not be able to see that you viewed their Story.
strings.Story.StealthMode.ControlText: Turn Stealth Mode on to hide the fact that you viewed peoples' stories from them.
strings.Story.StealthMode.Title: Stealth Mode
strings.Summary.ConnectionNotice: Summarization uses its own endpoint and key, separate from translation. The key stays in the local Keychain.
strings.Summary.EnabledNotice: When disabled, summary actions are hidden from chat menus, message menus and selection tools. API configuration is retained.
strings.Summary.PromptNotice: @text is the selected messages; @toLang is the app language. No unselected context or media is uploaded.
strings.Summary.RangeEmpty: No usable text in this interval, or messages could not be retrieved.
strings.Summary.RangeFailed: Message retrieval did not complete. Check the connection and retry.
strings.Summary.RangeInvalid: The start must precede the end.
strings.Summary.RangeNotice: Fetch text in this interval from the current chat or topic, then confirm upload to the summary API. Attachments, ephemeral, secret and protected content are excluded.
strings.Summary.RangeTooLarge: This interval exceeds the request limit. Choose a shorter interval. Text is not silently truncated and uploaded.
strings.Summary.Title: Message summary API
strings.Summary.TooLarge: Selected text exceeds 64 KB. Select fewer messages.
strings.Summary.UploadNotice: Send and summarize uploads the selected text above to your configured API. No images, audio, extra account metadata or unselected messages are attached. Your provider may charge for requests.
strings.Translation.Chat.Failed: Some messages could not be translated using %@. Turn chat translation off and on to retry.
strings.bookmarks.notice: Bookmarks store message references and local tags. A message that is not cached may still be available online. Removing a bookmark does not delete the message.
strings.bookmarks.removeConfirm: Remove %d bookmarks from this account? Messages stay in Telegram.
strings.bookmarks.state.failed: The message could not be loaded. You can retry.
strings.bookmarks.state.notCached: Not cached on this Mac. Fetch the message to view it.
strings.bookmarks.state.unavailable: This chat is unavailable to this account. You can retry if access changes.

strings.category.media.description: Link previews, photos, stickers and playback
strings.category.messages.description: Message actions, chat list and folders
strings.category.privacy.description: Content filters, deleted messages and privacy
strings.chat.notice: These preferences apply to this account and chat. Inherit uses the account setting. Hidden senders remain hidden when text filtering is disabled.
strings.chat.title: Chat Preferences
strings.dc.notice: Tests use this account and its active proxy/transport engine. The first request includes connection, authentication and RPC time; three later RPC samples are measured separately. Each request times out after eight seconds. The report contains only five averages.
strings.dc.title: Data-center diagnostics
strings.dns.failed: The lookup failed. Check the domain, resolver and network.
strings.dns.title: DNS Diagnostics
strings.emptyBookmarks: Add bookmarks from a message’s context menu.
strings.features.AutoInlineBot.Footer: When you enter a matching link on its own, that link is queried through the matching inline bot. Text beside the link is not queried.
strings.features.ChatFolderNoneAvailable: No folders are available. Create a folder first, or check whether this chat is already in every folder.
strings.features.CommunityAvatarTapAction.arrow: Open Community Only with the Bottom-Right Arrow
strings.features.GroupProfileSettings.Footer: Only selected items that are available for the current group and your permissions will be shown.
strings.features.HidePrivateChatActivities.Notic: Hides the other person’s typing, recording and other activity indicators in your private chats and chat list. Ghost Mode controls whether your own activity is sent to others.
strings.features.HideSavedAndArchivedMessagesInL: Hide Saved and Archived Messages in List
strings.features.HideTabBarPermissionWarnings.No: Hide exclamation badges caused by disabled notification or contacts access. Unread counts and other account reminders remain visible.
strings.features.InlineBotRules.Footer: Read-only rules update automatically. Each group shows the bot and its link patterns. Your original link stays in the input field.
strings.features.InlineBots.Title: Inline Bots
strings.features.InviteLinks.ConfirmAll: Revoke all additional invite links you created (%@ total)? The main link and other permanent links will not be affected. This cannot be undone.
strings.features.InviteLinks.ConfirmUnavailable: Revoke unavailable additional invite links (%@ total) that have expired or reached their usage limit? The main link, other permanent links, and usable additional links will not be affected. This cannot be undone.
strings.features.InviteLinks.FetchFailed: Couldn't load the complete list of additional invite links. Please try again later.
strings.features.InviteLinks.NoAdditional: No additional invite links can be revoked.
strings.features.InviteLinks.PartialFailure: Revoked: %1$@. Failed: %2$@. The list is refreshing.
strings.features.InviteLinks.ScopeInfo: Only additional, non-permanent invite links will be processed. The main link will not be affected.
strings.features.KeepNewChatsVisibleAtTop: Keep New Chats Visible at Top
strings.features.MessagePlaceholderInSaved: Here are your Saved Messages chats
strings.features.MutualContact.Description: This contact is a mutual contact.
strings.features.PanguInfo: Insert spaces between Chinese/Japanese/Korean text and Latin letters or numbers. These three options are independent. Sending follows your existing per-chat setting; code, links and text entities keep their formatting.
strings.features.TextStyleMenu.ItemsFooter: Enabled styles appear directly on the first level of the text selection menu. Tap Edit to reorder. Quote, Spoiler and Date are hidden in secret chats.
strings.features.TextStyleMenu.PositionFooter: The full Format menu always stays in its usual place. The system menu shows about 5 items per page; later items need “>” to page.
strings.features.TextStyleMenu.ResetConfirm: Reset all selection menu styles, order and position?
strings.features.UnpinAllMessagesAlert: Would you like to unpin all messages?
strings.fileError: Unable to read or save this file.
strings.filter.empty: Add a keyword or regular expression to filter incoming messages.
strings.font.clearDownloadsConfirm: Clear downloaded font files? This account will return to system font families. Imported fonts remain available.
strings.font.downloadFailed: The font download failed verification or could not finish. Try again.
strings.font.importFailed: Could not import this font. Choose a valid TTF, OTF or TTC file up to 64 MiB.
strings.font.notice: Import TTF, OTF or TTC files up to 64 MiB. Missing fonts and unsupported characters use system fallbacks. Settings backups include font choices; font files stay on this Mac.
strings.font.preview:
Regram · The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
中文字体预览 · 日本語の表示 · 한글 글꼴 미리보기
0123456789 — Bold and italic follow message formatting.
strings.font.removeConfirm: Remove this imported font? Selections using this face will return to a system font.
strings.font.removeFailed: The font files could not be removed.
strings.font.title: Fonts
strings.hidden.empty: Choose senders whose incoming messages should be hidden.
strings.history.title: Edit History
strings.inlineBots.notice: Matching standalone links are sent to the listed bot. Other draft text is never included. Dismiss the results to keep typing without another query.
strings.invalidBackup: This file is not a supported settings backup.
strings.invalidRules: Unable to import these rules. Check their format and expressions.
strings.localData.clearConfirm: This permanently clears the selected local records on this device. Current message content is preserved unless clearing retained deleted messages. No deletion request is sent to Telegram.
strings.localData.limits: Each edited message keeps the original and up to 49 recent versions. Each cached history image is limited to 8 MB, with 32 MB total per message.
strings.localData.notice: Scan cached message histories for chats, bookmarked chats and recently opened chats. Nothing is downloaded. Clearing only changes this device. Cancel stops after the current batch. Native storage settings manage ordinary downloaded media.
strings.localData.title: Local History Storage
strings.localPremium.notice: Enable local client features for this account. Server-enforced Premium permissions still require a subscription.
strings.manualInstall.detail: Install a new Regram version by replacing the application.
strings.manualInstall.title: Manual Installation
strings.mediaDetails.notice: Local values are read from the downloaded file. Declared values come from the message. Unknown values are unavailable without downloading; this page does not start a download.
strings.mediaDetails.title: Media Details
strings.messageExport.unavailable: This message is unavailable for image export. Keep the message visible and try again.
strings.messageMenu.description: Visible actions, drag to reorder and grouping
strings.messageMenu.notice: Drag to reorder. Disabled actions are hidden. Only actions available for a message appear.
strings.navigation.notice: Chats and Settings remain available. Use the row menus to move or hide tabs. The native Calls setting also controls the Calls tab; the Calls menu remains available when the tab is hidden.
strings.navigation.title: Navigation
strings.network.scope: Saving reconnects Telegram transports. This policy applies to native data-center connections, proxy DNS and signed backup discovery. Custom DNS failures never fall back to system DNS. DoH, webpages, HTTP APIs and WEB proxy carriers use their own networking. Explicit DNS or IP policies keep the Rust engine on native TCP transports.
strings.network.title: Network policy
strings.network.webProxyStrict: The WEB proxy carrier cannot enforce an IP family. Choose a SOCKS5 or MTProto proxy, or a non-strict IP policy.
strings.outgoingTranslation.failed: Translation failed. Your draft is unchanged. You can retry or cancel.
strings.outgoingTranslation.notice: Choose a target language to preview a translation before sending. Canceling or a failed translation keeps the original draft. Chat choices override the account default.
strings.outgoingTranslation.outdated: The draft, chat, or translation settings changed. Close this preview and try again.
strings.outgoingTranslation.title: Translate Before Sending
strings.protectedExport.notice: Allow local saves and message screenshots of protected cloud messages. Secret chats, one-time media and paid media remain excluded.
strings.quickTranslate.busy: Wait for a translation to finish or cancel one.
strings.quickTranslate.failed: Translation failed. Check the selected provider and try again.
strings.quickTranslate.notice: Show a button beside incoming foreign-language messages. Click to translate or show the original.
strings.quickTranslate.outdated: The message or translation settings changed. Try again.
strings.recent.empty: Chats you open will appear here.
strings.resetConfirm: Reset settings for this account? Bookmarks and messages are kept.
strings.retained.clearConfirm: Delete these loaded retained messages from this device? Messages are not deleted for other participants.
strings.retained.notice: Select a chat to browse locally retained messages. Only messages received while retention was enabled are available.
strings.retained.title: Retained Messages
strings.rules: rules will be merged after removing duplicates.
strings.screenshotReport.notice: Do not send secret-chat screenshot service messages from this client.
strings.service.credentialsNotice: Credentials are specific to this service and are excluded from backups.
strings.service.translation.description: Endpoint, model, API key and prompt
strings.setting.profileDefaultTabGroupsInCommon: Prefer groups in common on profiles
strings.setting.unlimitedPinnedChats: Keep Overflow Pins on This Device
strings.summary.dateFormat: Use local time in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm format.
strings.summary.empty: There are no text messages to summarize.
strings.summary.invalidRange: Enter a valid time range ending no later than now.
strings.summary.outdated: The selected messages or summary settings changed. Review the messages again before retrying.
strings.summary.rangeFailed: Unable to load this time range. Please try again.
strings.summary.rangeNotice: Load messages from this chat and topic, then review the exact text before sending. Secret, protected, one-time and attachment messages are skipped. Up to 5000 messages and 64000 bytes.
strings.summary.sameChat: Select messages from the same chat and topic.
strings.summary.tooLarge: Choose a smaller range. Selections support up to 100 messages; time ranges support up to 5000 messages. The text must fit within 64000 bytes.
strings.summary.unsupported: Secret, protected, one-time and attachment messages cannot be sent to the summary service.
strings.summary.uploadNotice: Only the text shown above will be sent to your configured summary service when you choose Summarize.
strings.transcription.tasksEmpty: There are no speech recognition tasks.
strings.transcription.tasksNotice: Tasks are shared across windows for this account. Sleep interrupts active work; waking retries it after checking the message and current service settings. Cancel stops the shared request.
strings.transfer.notice: Counts real Telegram media response payload across accounts since launch, including retry traffic. Cached reads, font downloads and protocol overhead are excluded.
strings.transfer.rate: Average over the last three seconds
strings.transfer.title: Media transfer statistics
strings.translation.contextNotice: Off by default. When enabled, LLM translation sends up to 5 earlier messages from the same chat and topic, limited to 800 characters each. Hidden, secret, protected and one-time messages are excluded.
strings.translation.systemUnavailable: System translation requires macOS 15 or later.
strings.webTranslation.failed: Webpage translation failed. You can restore the original or try again.
strings.webTranslation.noText: This page has no readable text to translate.
strings.webTranslation.notice: Translate sends visible page text to your selected translation service. Forms, editors, code, hidden text and iframe contents are excluded. Restore keeps changes made by the website.
strings.webTranslation.outdated: Translation settings changed. Restore the page and translate again.
strings.webTranslation.title: Webpage Translation
strings.webTranslation.tooLarge: This page is too large to translate. The limit is 2000 text nodes and 500000 bytes.
strings.Bookmarks.LocalNotice: Bookmarks and tags are stored on this Mac. Open a message to view it in its original chat.

macos.Settings.Editor.bottomBarLayout.Descript: Telegram bottom bar with optional contacts
macos.Browser.Translation.SystemUnavailable: Apple webpage translation is unavailable on this Mac. Select another translation service.
macos.EraseData.Notice: Logs out every account and deletes Regram’s local data, caches and settings on this Mac. You will need to log in again.
macos.LLMTranslation.ConnectionNotice: Enter the service address, optionally including /v1 or the full request path. Regram completes the path automatically. API keys stay in this device’s keychain and are excluded from backups.
macos.Mention.UserIdLink.Notice: Mentions use the user’s full name instead of @username. Right-click an avatar and choose Mention; clicking the inserted mention opens their profile.
macos.MessageFilter.Rules.Notice: Click a rule to limit it to specific chats. Right-click for more options.
macos.NetworkPolicy.DoHNotice: Built-in DNS uses Google and Cloudflare over HTTPS. System DNS resolves proxy hostnames through macOS. Custom DoH uses DNS JSON and also serves signed backup-DC TXT queries; existing wire-format address endpoints remain compatible. A custom resolver failure never downgrades to system DNS. Resolver hostnames still use system DNS to bootstrap.
macos.RecentChats.Notice: Chats you opened on this Mac, newest first.
macos.Revoked.Notice: Choose a chat to browse revoked messages already retained on this device. Reads bounded local pages; Load More searches older pages. Dates show original message dates.
macos.Settings.ContextMenu.Notice: Turn an item off to hide it. Drag items to reorder them. This list includes Regram actions and other menu items available to the current account.
macos.Summary.EnabledNotice: Show Message Summary in the chat’s top-right menu. Turning it off keeps your service configuration.
macos.AppUpdate.MacAutomaticNotice: Check for updates when Regram opens and periodically while it is running. Updates can download in the background and install when you quit.
macos.AppUpdate.MacReadOnly: Move Regram to Applications and open it from there before updating.
macos.AppUpdate.InvalidRelease: Unable to find valid update information for this Mac. Please try again later.
macos.AppUpdate.NetworkError: Unable to reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
macos.ImageTranslation.TooLarge: This image has too much text to translate at once. Select some text or crop the image and try again.
